outlets.name: Wisconsin State Journal (madison.com)
outlets.credible: Madison's daily newspaper of record (since 1839); dining reviews and openings/closings.

outlets.name: The Cap Times
outlets.credible: Madison's progressive daily-turned-digital newsroom (since 1917); bylined dining coverage incl. James Beard reporting.

outlets.name: Isthmus
outlets.credible: Madison's alt-weekly (since 1976); associate editor Linda Falkenstein is the city's long-time food writer; venue listings + reader polls.

outlets.name: Madison Magazine / Channel 3000
outlets.credible: Madison's city magazine (WISC-TV); Best of Madison reader vote; covers James Beard nominations.

outlets.name: City Cast Madison
outlets.credible: Local daily news podcast/newsletter (City Cast network); 'best of' guides with named local food writers (e.g. Isthmus' Falkenstein on fish fry).

outlets.name: UpNorthNews — Madison Food Guide (reader surveys)
outlets.credible: Statewide Wisconsin digital news outlet; annual Madison reader-vote food guide (best curds/fish fry/old fashioned). Used as a popularity vote, corroborating only.

outlets.name: WKOW 27 (Madison ABC)
outlets.credible: Madison broadcast newsroom; reports James Beard honors and closures.

outlets.name: James Beard Foundation
outlets.credible: Institutional authority (awards: Odessa Piper/L'Etoile 2001, Tory Miller 2012, Fairchild 2023 Best Chef Midwest; semifinalists). Its 'Ask a Chef' interviews are chef recommendations — counted as ONE credible source, not lone authority.

outlets.name: Destination Madison (CVB)
outlets.credible: Official convention & visitors bureau; keeps the Madison James Beard honors list.

outlets.name: Travel Wisconsin (WI Dept. of Tourism)
outlets.credible: State tourism office; vetted listings + 'Wisconsin chefs making waves' features.

outlets.name: The Infatuation (Madison reviews)
outlets.credible: National restaurant-review desk with a Madison city guide and bylined reviews.

outlets.name: Wisconsin Public Radio
outlets.credible: Statewide public broadcaster; food/James Beard coverage.

outlets.name: Experience Wisconsin magazine
outlets.credible: Statewide travel magazine with bylined writers (e.g. Kevin Revolinski, WI travel-guide author).

outlets.name: Wikipedia (notability + published coordinates)
outlets.credible: Notability index + published coordinates for landmarks; pinning source, needs a 2nd recommender.
